claims.claim: Israel's standard VAT rate is 18%, in effect since 01.01.2025 (raised from 17%) and held through 2026. Example: net 15,000 NIS x 18% = 2,700 NIS VAT, total 17,700 NIS.
claims.raw_snippet: סכום המע"מ מחושב בשיעור קבוע ממחיר העסקה או הסחורה, והחל מיום 01.01.2025 הוא עומד על 18% ממחיר הרכישה או השירות (לפני כן, עד 31.12.2024, השיעור היה 17%).
claims.verification_note: gov.il returns HTTP 403 to scripted fetches; the 18% rate (in force since 1.1.2025, unchanged for 2026) was confirmed by reading the Tax Authority's rate page in a browser.

claims.claim: Allocation-number net thresholds (before VAT): May 2024 > 25,000 NIS (25,000 ש"ח); Jan 2025 > 20,000 NIS (20,000 ש"ח); Jan 2026 > 10,000 NIS (10,000 ש"ח); from June 1 2026 > 5,000 NIS (5,000 ש"ח).

claims.claim: From June 1, 2026 the obligation to obtain an allocation number for a tax invoice expands to transactions exceeding 5,000 NIS (5,000 ש"ח) before VAT; this step-down is in effect, accelerated from the originally scheduled 2028 date.
claims.raw_snippet: החל מיום 1.6.2026 תורחב החובה לקבל מספר הקצאה לחשבונית מס, כך שתחול על עסקאות שסכומן עולה על 5,000 ש"ח (לפני מע"מ).

claims.claim: The allocation-number duty was enacted by the Economic Arrangements Law (חוק ההתייעלות הכלכלית התשפ"ג-2023) amending the VAT Law (חוק מע"מ): section 47 / Section 47 / סעיף 47 governs the duty to obtain an allocation number on a tax invoice, and section 38 / סעיף 38 makes the allocation number a condition for the buyer to deduct input VAT (ניכוי מס התשומות). There is NO Amendment 157. The 2024 threshold was 25,000 ש"ח before VAT.
claims.raw_snippet: במסגרת חוק ההתייעלות הכלכלית (תיקוני חקיקה להשגת יעדי התקציב לשנים 2023 ו-2024), התשפ"ג-2023, נקבע בסעיף 47 לחוק מע"מ כי עוסק יידרש לקבל מרשות המסים מספר הקצאה לחשבונית מס כתנאי לניכוי מס התשומות לפי סעיף 38. בשנת 2024 חלה החובה על חשבוניות מעל 25,000 ש"ח (לפני מע"מ).

claims.claim: An Israeli TIN / mispar osek is a 9-digit number validated with a Luhn-style check digit: the weighted digit sum is valid when sum modulo 10 == 0.
claims.raw_snippet: The Luhn algorithm verifies a number against its check digit by summing the digits (doubling every second digit and reducing values over 9); the number is valid when the total modulo 10 is equal to 0. Israeli ID and business numbers (9 digits) use this scheme.
claims.verification_note: The cited Wikipedia Luhn page does not document the Israeli scheme. The weights [1,2,1,2,...] with digit-fold and mod-10 were verified directly by executing the algorithm against known-valid Israeli numbers, and match the implementation in the israeli-id-validator skill. Treat as algorithmic, not source-quoted.

claims.claim: Illustrative figures used in the skill's worked examples, all consistent with the verified 18% VAT rate and the SHAAM document-type rules. Example 1 (tax invoice 305): net 15,000 NIS (15,000 ש"ח) + 18% VAT 2,700 = total 17,700 NIS (17,700 ש"ח). Example 2 (plain receipt/kabala): 500 NIS (500 ש"ח) cash payment, no allocation number. Example 3 (credit invoice 330): partial refund of 3,000 NIS (3,000 ש"ח), no allocation number, references the original invoice.
claims.raw_snippet: VAT at 18%: 15,000 x 0.18 = 2,700; 15,000 + 2,700 = 17,700. The same 18% rate applies to the worked examples (net 15,000 ש"ח, total 17,700 ש"ח; a 500 ש"ח cash receipt; a 3,000 ש"ח credit/refund).
claims.verification_note: This is the skill's own worked arithmetic (15,000 x 18% = 2,700), recomputed rather than quoted from a source.

The Tax Authority's operative criterion for requiring an allocation number is the VAT amount, not the net amount: more than 3,600 NIS for 2025, more than 1,800 NIS from 1.1.2026, and more than 900 NIS from 1.6.2026.
claims.raw_snippet: הקריטריון לבקשת מספר הקצאה ודיווח בדוח המפורט הינו סכום המע"מ כנגזרת של הסכום הקבוע בחוק. כלומר, לשנת 2025 נדרש מספר הקצאה רק כאשר סכום המע"מ גבוה מ-3,600 ₪, החל מיום 1.1.2026 נדרש מספר הקצאה רק כאשר סכום המע"מ גבוה מ-1,800 ₪, והחל מיום 1.6.2026 נדרש מספר הקצאה רק כאשר סכום המע"מ גבוה מ-900 ₪.

claims.claim: Where an invoice's VAT value is lower than the VAT derived from the transaction amount that triggers the allocation requirement, there is no obligation to request an allocation number, and the customer receiving such an invoice does not need one to deduct input VAT. The Tax Authority nonetheless recommends requesting a number on all invoices for process uniformity, and states the answer applies to other dealers operating similarly.
claims.raw_snippet: וערך המע"מ בחשבונית קטן מסכום המע"מ הנגזר מסכום עסקה החייב במספר הקצאה, הרי שאין חובה לפנות לקבלת מספר הקצאה בגין אותה עסקה, והלקוח שמקבל כזו חשבונית, אינו נדרש למספר הקצאה לצורך ניכוי מס תשומות

claims.claim: On refusal the requester is offered four alternatives: cancel the request; continue without an allocation number; continue and offer the buyer a reverse charge, available only where the buyer is a registered osek murshe; or apply to the control unit and set a hearing. The reverse-charge route requires cancelling the refused invoice and issuing a new one with identical details except a zero VAT value and a different reference number, which receives a special allocation number and is reported as a zero-rated transaction.
claims.raw_snippet: בפני מבקש ההקצאה יוצגו לבחירה 4 החלופות הבאות: 1. ביטול הבקשה למספר הקצאה. 2. המשך העסקה ללא קבלת מספר הקצאה. 3. המשך העסקה - הצעה לקונה לקבל על עצמו את תשלום המס ("היפוך חיוב")

claims.claim: Emergency allocation numbers are intended solely for a technological failure of the Tax Authority's own systems, not for a local communication fault. On a local failure the issuer has three options: request the number through the standalone application; wait, within the period the law allows (up to 14 days from the tax point), until the fault is fixed and only then issue the invoice; or issue the invoice without a number and request one retroactively once the fault is fixed.
claims.raw_snippet: בכל מקרה של כשל "מקומי" - עומדות לרשות מוציא החשבונית 3 חלופות

claims.claim: An invoice dated after 4.5.2024 that requires an allocation number and does not carry one is disallowed as an input, and the input is automatically reduced from the inputs included in the detailed report. Deducting input VAT on the basis of a tax invoice with no allocation number is an offence under the VAT Law.

claims.claim: In the reverse-charge alternative the supplier issues the customer an invoice with VAT at a rate of zero that DOES include an allocation number, and the customer issues a self-invoice and reports the allocation number from that zero invoice in the detailed report. An ordinary self-invoice unrelated to the new law needs no allocation number.
